purpose: Replace the operator-confounded V7 residual model with one common-CIC, three-code, target-free conditional location-scale likelihood without post-hoc power rescaling.

data.target_operator: exact periodic cell-centred raw-particle CIC at 0.3125 Mpc/h; log10(rho/box_mean)/4.5; finite positive values retained without clipping or floor

frozen_backbone.role: unchanged deterministic conditional mean and input preprocessing

deterministic_mean_correction.architecture: ConditionalResidualUNet, four condition channels, base_channels=16, zero-initialized output
deterministic_mean_correction.target: truth minus frozen V4 mean, exact per-cube DC removed
deterministic_mean_correction.output_projection: subtract exact spatial mean on every forward pass
deterministic_mean_correction.loss: 0.5 uniform voxel MSE + 0.5 train-only density-tail-weighted voxel MSE
deterministic_mean_correction.tail_frequency_weighting: equal one-third average of the three training-source voxel probabilities; inverse square root; cap 10; renormalize to expectation one
deterministic_mean_correction.augmentation: all 48 signed cube isometries: 6 axis permutations times 8 reflections
deterministic_mean_correction.selection: Among candidates improving combined validation MSE over the exact zero-correction baseline in every source, minimize the worst source-relative validation MSE; smallest step breaks an exact tie.

location_scale_model.fit_stage: after the deterministic correction checkpoint is selected, before EDM residual cache preparation
location_scale_model.cube_location: source-balanced ridge prediction of residual DC
location_scale_model.band_0_scale: exp of equal-source training mean log RMS; no observable regression
location_scale_model.band_1_scale: exp of equal-source training mean log RMS; no observable regression
location_scale_model.band_2_scale: exp of source-balanced ridge prediction of log RMS
location_scale_model.band_3_scale: exp of source-balanced ridge prediction of log RMS
location_scale_model.ridge_selection: per predicted target, five-fold equal-source train-only CV with fold-local feature scaling
location_scale_model.transform: subtract predicted DC; split into four exhaustive non-DC Fourier bands; divide each band by its positive predicted scale; sum standardized bands
location_scale_model.inverse: split the generated standardized residual with the same masks; multiply by the same target-free predicted scales; sum; add predicted DC

stochastic_edm.sigma_data: equal-source RMS fitted from the three standardized training residual caches only
stochastic_edm.loss: 0.5 uniform EDM denoising + 0.5 original-truth density-tail-weighted EDM denoising
stochastic_edm.tail_weights: the same frozen three-source training-only weights as deterministic correction

development_selection.field_gate: all eight unchanged checks from src/hong2021_v6_gate.py must pass independently in all three development domains
development_selection.selection: select the smallest predeclared step passing every field check in all three domains
development_selection.failure: if no candidate passes all three domains, this V14 attempt fails and no Astrid file is downloaded or opened

locked_independent_order_after_developme: freeze the selected mean-correction checkpoint, location-scale JSON, EDM checkpoint, preprocessing, representative rules, commands, and SHA256 hashes in a committed record
verify zero local Astrid files before the commit
download and prepare raw-CIC Astrid CV0-26 only after that commit
sample exactly one predeclared observer per realization with ensemble16, 40 steps, and seed 28777
run the unchanged eight-check Astrid field gate once
run unchanged Astrid grid-HOP only if and after the field gate passes
never try another checkpoint, scale, seed, subset, target operator, or threshold after seeing Astrid
forbidden: EAGLE RefL0100N1504 or Astrid truth in fitting or selection
historical SIMBA CV0-15 in fitting or selection
post-hoc A(k), scalar amplitude transfer, clipping, pseudocount, or learned floor
